About MOH

A dependable technical partner for your project team.

MOH Design Solutions supports design and construction workflows with drafting, planning assistance, quantity estimation and technical documentation. Our aim is to make project information easier to understand, coordinate and use.

  • ✓Work aligned with your brief, references and deliverables
  • ✓Clear communication and organised drawing files
  • ✓Flexible support for individual tasks and project packages
  • ✓Coordination-focused approach to drawings and quantities

Our Process

Simple, organised, collaborative.

A straightforward workflow helps us understand your requirements and deliver the agreed scope clearly.

STEP 01

Share Your Brief

Send drawings, reference files, project details and the required output.

STEP 02

Confirm the Scope

We discuss deliverables, timeline, assumptions and the information needed.

STEP 03

Develop the Work

Drafting, quantity preparation or documentation proceeds against the agreed brief.

STEP 04

Review & Handover

We share the agreed files for your review and address feedback within the scope.
